spans.text: ...At Griffin HQ.
Are you alright?
Huh?! I-I'm fine!
But you've spilled your coffee.
Oh!
I'm sorry, I'll clean it up right away!
Are you still worried about them?
Well, they're Griffin Dolls, but they haven't gone through their neural cloud debugging yet.
They were thrown together at the last minute, and they'll probably have a harder time working together than any other team, so I'm worried that things will go wrong for them...
Look on the bright side...
This is all valuable combat experience. It'll help them grow a lot faster than through combat sims.
That's true... Their specs aren't actually bad at all, so the sooner they get their neural clouds fixed up, the better.
The comms equipment in the Command Room suddenly starts ringing.
Excuse me... Wait, this is data from VHS!
C-Commander! They completed their mission!
And there it is, good news.
I'm sending it to you right now!
So these are Ouroboros' earliest combat sim logs and data?
They also found one of Ouroboros' spare bodies, though...she fought them and ran off.
I'm glad our Dolls are alright. I'll get Svarog to take care of Ouroboros' body.
But the important thing is that we now know for sure Paradeus has already taken Ouroboros' data.
If the reports are correct, then William must have also taken part of this abandoned Sangvis AI cultivation system.
Are they planning to make new AIs?
Without these memory fragments, it would never have occurred to me that a Doll's neural cloud could be honed in such a cruel fashion.
William would definitely make use of this and build a neural cloud that's only concerned about achieving its end and completely unbound by ethics.
The fact that Paradeus haven't fielded too many Dolls was probably due to technical inadequacies.
But the situation has changed now... From now on, we'll probably encounter new Paradeus units that are even more ruthless and efficient.
Sounds like trouble.
It's just a guess on my part. We'll need more concrete evidence to substantiate it.
So are you going to give Miss Persica a copy of this data when she arrives?
Yeah, we'll let her handle the rest.
Also, there's an attachment... Looks like a group photo of them?
Did they send it to reassure us of their safety?
Hehe, it says Liu insisted that they do this.
Yeah, none of them except Liu and AUG Para seems too happy about it.
...Still, they look well.
Yeah.
...Oh yeah, do we have a decent camera in HQ?
Commander, are you thinking about...?
Once we get everything back to normal, we ought to commemorate it.
Um... Yeah, I guess we should.
After all, we might not get the chance to do it in the future.
Huh?
I'll go take care of the Dolls. I'll be off now, Commander!
(Sighs)
She almost sounded friendly... And here I thought she wasn't mad at me anymore...
Did she really take my joke THAT seriously?
